[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Steep Ravine Trail is a popular trail in Mount Tamalpais State Park.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Trail details for Steep Ravine Trail:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] * Distance: 4.5 miles out and back (or 6.5 miles as a loop with the Dipsea Trail).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] * Elevation Gain: 1,000 feet.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] * Difficulty: Moderate to strenuous (due to steep sections and stairs).  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] * Time: 2-4 hours.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] * Trail Type: Out and back or loop.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] * Surface: Dirt trail with stairs and steep sections.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The trail begins at the Steep Ravine Environmental Campground, following the Steep Ravine Creek.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The trail features steep staircases and narrow sections, with stunning views of the Pacific Ocean and the Bay Area.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for the hike include bringing plenty of water and snacks, wearing comfortable hiking shoes, and being prepared for changing weather conditions.
